memberdef.argsstring: (const M2::ARingCCC &C, int nbits, const M2::ARingCCC::ElementType &a, const M2::ARingCCC::ElementType &b)
memberdef.name: almostEqual

briefdescription.para: gtest coverage for the MPC-backed M2::ARingCCC arbitrary-precision complex aring.

detaileddescription.para: Plugs M2::ARingCCC into the ARingTest.hpp harness with a precision-aware almostEqual that scales 2^-nbits to the ring's get_precision() and checks the real and imaginary components of a - b against it independently so the tolerance tracks the configured MPFR / MPC precision rather than being pinned to 53 bits. getElement<M2::ARingCCC> supplies the standard mix of deterministic edge-case prefix elements (zero, one, i, near-overflow exponents) and random complex draws; testSomeMore runs the full arithmetic / equality / inverse / negation battery on top.

Counterpart of ARingCCTest.cpp (the 53-bit complex<double> companion); together with ARingRRTest.cpp / ARingRRRTest.cpp / ARingRRiTest.cpp they form the file-aring-real-complex-tests family. The cross-backend agreement guard is the standard MPC vs. complex<double> convergence check at 53 bits.
